name: Ring of Water Elemental Command
description: While wearing this ring, you have advantage on attack rolls against elementals from the Elemental Plane of Water and they have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. In addition, you have access to properties based on the Elemental Plane of Water. The ring has 5 charges. It regains 1d4 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. Spells cast from the ring have a save DC of 17. You can expend 2 of the ring's charges to cast dominate monster on a water elemental. In addition, you can stand on and walk across liquid surfaces as if they were solid ground. You can also speak and understand Aquan.
